notes.content:
* Offline mode,

notes.title: Big Update!

tags.bug: ■ A huge number of minor fixes and fixes;

tags.feature: ■ Completely redesigned the main technical base of the game;
■ Made a lot of graphical improvements;
■ Added anti-aliasing and sharpening when scaling;
■ Added support for 1440p WQHD monitors.
■ Also improved support for small laptop monitors;
■ And Now the game supports a whole bunch of monitors, aspect ratios, and other display options;
■ Updated system requirements and added the latest information there;
■ And Now the game looks beautiful regardless of your display;
■ We did not forget about the support of the windowed mode, which is so convenient to play at work :)
■ Everything has changed. Now the game has a new, beautiful and smoothed menu;
■ Improved controls section, added tips;
■ Completely changed the game interface;
■ Removed unnecessary, and added the necessary buttons to the gameplay interface;
■ The interface can be disabled on the fly by pressing "I" or through settings;
■ Reworked 5 new backgrounds for levels. Now they have become softer, more pleasant and more comfortable;
■ Backgrounds can be switched by numbers 1/2/3/4/5, or with a mouse;
■ Added a new, fourth lighting scheme or "skin" for levels;
■ We made a global redesign of the store page and SOK PRO library, how do you like it? =)
■ We released a completely FREE dlc with 18+ content;
■ DLC includes the processing of 100 levels from SOK PRO;
